run_gpt2_training: run GPT-2 training with unlikelihood sequence penalty loss and maximum likelihood estimation
eval_singletoken_perplexity: evaluate GPT-2 model perplexity and token-level metrics on a dataset split
sample_text_continuations: sample text continuations from a GPT-2 model using top-k and top-p filtering
compute_unlikelihood_loss: compute unlikelihood sequence penalty loss that penalizes n-gram repetitions
filter_logits_top_k_top_p: filter logits distribution using top-k and nucleus top-p sampling strategies
